_comment: One entry per row of the precedence table in rules/common/80-pstack.md (details in skills/pstack-adapter, Overrides). Each row quotes the pstack text it overrides, verbatim, with the file it sits in (relative to the repo in source.json). A later jig check warns when a quote is no longer in the fetched pack, which means an upgrade rewrote or dropped that text and the row needs a fresh look. `verifiedAt` is the upstream commit the quotes were last checked against. Nothing from upstream is copied here beyond these short quotes (rules/decisions/2026-10-19-pstack-precedence-table.md).

quotes.text: Open every PR ready, never as a draft.
Open the PR ready, never draft, per **Opening a PR**.
Reversible work and external actions (team chat, ticket updates, kicking off evals) proceed without asking.
File each Backlog item to your team's devex or backlog tracker without waiting.
Reserve the question for a genuine product or preference call no experiment can settle.
If the dir survives on ignored build artifacts, `rm -rf` it, then `git worktree prune`.
landing the contiguous verified run bottom-up through `gh` by default
Before commit → the `deslop` skill from the `cursor-team-kit` plugin (`/deslop`).
`cursor-team-kit` publishes `control-cli` (CLIs and TUIs) and `control-ui` (browser / Electron / web UIs).
Agent-facing prose also follows the **create-skill** skill (Cursor's built-in for authoring SKILL.md files).
Trivial existing-skill edit (a one-line bullet, a tightened sentence, a stale fact corrected): the parent does it directly.
Otherwise default to `.cursor/skills/<handle>-mode/SKILL.md` in the project
When the operator corrects you, fix the mistake and add the rule.
